epics.title: Contracts and delivery
epics.goal: Run a contract from draft to close with versioned BOQ, guarantees, change chain, measurement-to-acceptance and contractor evaluation, with money invariants enforced in the database.

epics.title: Payments and Treasury
epics.goal: Pay contractors against a database-enforced cumulative ledger, recover advances, exchange files with the Treasury, reconcile and settle, with no double claim possible even under concurrent users.

epics.title: Issues and field obstacles
epics.goal: Give every obstacle an owner, a working-calendar deadline, independent closure and escalation to the unit and the task force.

epics.title: Quality, site diary and acceptance
epics.goal: Digitise the site diary, inspections, quality acceptance, test results and non-conformances with hashed signatures and the quality-accepted event for CTR.

epics.title: Legal records and permits
epics.goal: Track permits and their milestones as data with legal basis, evaluate gates that block contract, construction and handover commands, and warn before expiry.

epics.title: Land clearance and compensation
epics.goal: Track parcels, affected households, inventory, compensation plans, posting, payment, complaints, enforcement and site handover with strict protection of household personal data.

epics.title: Handover, assets and warranty
epics.goal: Hand over completed works with a punch list, record assets, track warranty obligations and claims and feed retention release and post-investment evaluation.

epics.title: State-standard documents, signing contract and registers
epics.goal: One shared engine that renders ND 30/2020 compliant documents, signs them (leader PAdES, post-signature numbering by incremental update, organization seal), keeps the outgoing/incoming registers and dossiers, and lets every other module request issuance through ports instead of building its own PDFs.

epics.title: Inspection, audit and recommendation follow-up
epics.goal: Track every inspection or audit from engagement to conclusion, findings, recommendations, remediation evidence and financial recovery tied to PAY, with confidential scope, separated verification and follow-up reports issued through DOC.

epics.title: Contractor selection and evidence-grounded AI analysis
epics.goal: Run the investor side of contractor selection (plans, criteria, contractors, sealed proposals, results, petitions, file reconciliation) in R1 without AI, then add OCR and AI analysis whose every finding cites a verified page and whose conclusions are always made by humans, routed only to domestic or self-hosted models.

epics.title: AI governance, classification-based routing and FinOps
epics.goal: The single gateway to every model: server-computed data classification, routing of confidential, important and personal data only to domestic or self-hosted models, mandatory evals on every allowed route before a profile is published, budget reservation, kill switch and recorded human decisions for every consequential AI output.

epics.title: Dynamic BI with metrics as code and permission-checked drill
epics.goal: A semantic layer where metrics are versioned code, every number carries its period and snapshot, access is closed by default, drill re-checks permissions at the destination and exports run per recipient scope.

epics.title: Data governance, quality, lineage and maturity
epics.goal: Turn data governance into data and commands: dataset catalog with owners, quality rules and runs with honest NOT_ASSESSED states, incidents with assignees and separated verification, reconciliation between sources, versioned data contracts with consumer consent, lineage with permission checks and evidence-based maturity scoring.

epics.title: Platform kernel, delivery and operations
epics.goal: Everything that is not a business module: risk spikes, environments and CI/CD, tenancy and security controls, contract-first generation, observability, resilience, data protection, quality gates, data migration, pilot, rollout and hypercare. Owns coverage of all 53 non-functional requirements.

epics.title: Flutter smartphone application
epics.goal: One Flutter code base for iOS and Android serving leaders, reporting officers, field staff, accountants and AI summary readers: OIDC+PKCE login, tenant theme, offline command queue with the UNKNOWN state, isolated PowerSync, attachments, push, and thin mobile slices of the report, approval and field flows.

epics.title: Identity, tenant boundary and effective access
epics.goal: Every request runs inside one authenticated tenant context and is allowed or denied by one policy decision point using the unit tree, scopes and entitlements.

epics.title: Tenant administration, approval authority and platform services
epics.goal: Tenant administrators run the organisation, access, approval authority and data governance themselves, on top of shared audit, outbox, idempotency and legal-hold services.

epics.title: Control plane: tenant lifecycle, entitlement, license and billing
epics.goal: The platform operator can create, run, bill and retire tenants, and every module can ask one entitlement service what a tenant is allowed to do.

epics.title: Notification Center
epics.goal: Domain events become the right notification, once, on the right channel, with consent, quiet hours, retry and proof of receipt where required.

epics.title: Omnichannel interaction center
epics.goal: Staff handle two-way conversations with contractors, investors and citizens in one shared inbox, tied to projects and issues, with consent, SLA and no cross-tenant or cross-channel mistakes.

epics.title: Master data, glossary and administrative succession
epics.goal: Give every capital, report and monitoring record effective-dated reference data (funds, programmes, calendar, agencies, 2025 administrative succession), an approved glossary where the D03 disbursement definitions are signed, and reversible merge, so reports keep the names and codes valid on their business date.

epics.title: Project bank, PIMA lifecycle and disbursement accountability
epics.goal: One project register with a guarded PIMA lifecycle (concept to closed), appraisal scoring, mandatory national project code, named leaders, task forces and time-boxed explanations, so capital is only planned for appraised, coded projects and slow projects have an accountable owner.

epics.title: Capital sources, plans, availability control and reallocation
epics.goal: Track capital from the decision that assigns it to the dong that is spent: appropriations by origin, published plan revisions per project, an append-only ledger with balances, availability control, reallocation from slow to fast projects, carry-over and fiscal-year close, and registration of planned disbursement.

epics.title: Weekly disbursement reporting, period snapshots and executive numbers
epics.goal: The pilot core and the only flow evidenced by the original source documents: investors file the weekly disbursement report (volume, six funding cells, next-month registration) on web and mobile, reviewers accept it, periods lock with reasoned reopen, and frozen period snapshots publish the two parallel disbursement rates by Treasury payment date, warnings, rankings and plans. Golden numbers (FX-DIS-001..007) are built now and stay awaiting the D03 sign-off.

epics.title: Executive overview and disbursement command center
epics.goal: Answer in 30 seconds where disbursement stands against both denominators, which units and projects are slow, who is accountable and what is waiting, with every number carrying scope, time, formula and a drill path that keeps the snapshot and re-checks permission.

epics.title: Statutory monitoring and evaluation reporting
epics.goal: Generate the statutory investment monitoring and evaluation reports from the same frozen disbursement snapshots, on a legal calendar of obligations, approved, issued through the document engine, exported for manual filing and tracked for lateness, with every template and deadline marked as awaiting legal confirmation until confirmed.

stories.title: Contract register, draft and joint-venture parties
stories.narrative: As a contract officer I can create a contract draft under a tendered package, revise it and set joint-venture parties so that the contract is ready for review with the price ceiling and parties validated.

acceptance.given: a tendered package with budget 10,200,000,000 VND and an approved capital plan
acceptance.then: 10.3bn returns 422 CONTRACT_VALUE_EXCEEDS_CEILING with ceiling_vnd=10200000000; 10.2bn creates a DRAFT with estimate_ceiling_vnd=10200000000; a package without an approved plan returns 422 CAPITAL_PLAN_NOT_APPROVED and creates no row

acceptance.given: createContract with code HD-A-300 sent twice with the same Idempotency-Key, then once with a new key
acceptance.then: second call returns the first body; same key with a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; new key with same code returns 409 CONTRACT_CODE_DUPLICATE; exactly 1 contract and 1 ctr.contract.created.v1 outbox row exist

acceptance.given: a joint-venture draft with members 60 percent and 40 percent of work value 6bn and 4bn
acceptance.when: parties are replaced with 60+30, then 60+40, and a direct SQL update drops a share after SIGNED
acceptance.then: 60+30 returns 422 JV_SHARE_NOT_100; 60+40 is accepted with sum of work value equal to contract value; the direct update fails at commit with SQLSTATE 23514 from the deferred trigger

acceptance.given: a guest contractor user scoped to HD-A-001
acceptance.when: the user lists and opens contracts including HD-A-002 and a contract of another tenant
acceptance.then: list has 1 row; other ids return 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, never 403; the response omits accepted_total_vnd and ledger fields

effort.assumption: Largest first CTR slice: includes the contract aggregate DDL (expand migration from schema_reference.sql), status-change history, JV constraint trigger and the list/detail UI. Needs IAM tenant context, RLS policy template, audit/outbox/idempotency kernel and DoA matrix (cross-group request). Also needs MDM contractor master and BID package result (cross-group).

stories.title: Guarantees: register, verify, extend by replacement, release with evidence, expiry alerts
stories.narrative: As a chief accountant I can verify and release guarantees and be warned before they expire so that no performance or advance guarantee lapses unnoticed.

acceptance.given: guarantee BL-A-002 PENDING_VERIFICATION registered by the contract officer
acceptance.when: the registrant verifies, then the chief accountant verifies, extends and releases without then with evidence
acceptance.then: self-verify returns 403 SELF_APPROVAL_DENIED; verify gives ACTIVE; extend creates a new PENDING_VERIFICATION row with extended_from_id and the old row SUPERSEDED with unchanged expires_at; release without release_evidence_id is rejected and with evidence sets RELEASED and released_at

acceptance.given: an ACTIVE advance guarantee expiring 2026-12-01 with outstanding advance 1.25bn
acceptance.when: the guarantee-expiry job runs on 2026-11-01, 11-16, 11-24 (twice) and 12-02
acceptance.then: exactly 3 notifications with last_alert_days 30, 15, 7 and none on the repeat run; status stays ACTIVE until expiry, then EXPIRED with one ISS issue created; requestAdvance returns 422 ADVANCE_GUARANTEE_REQUIRED

effort.assumption: Alert delivery uses the in-app notification port from the NOT module (cross-group request); the ISS auto-issue is wired through the intake story ST-ISS-005 at integration time. Guarantee amount rules are rule-data pending CXN-02/CXN-EXE-04.

stories.title: Review, signing and activation with permit gate, guarantee and capital commit
stories.narrative: As an approver within my delegation limit I can sign and activate a contract so that it becomes effective only when conflicts of interest, performance guarantee, permit gate and capital commitment all pass.

acceptance.given: a reviewer with a declared conflict against contractor NT-A-01
acceptance.when: the reviewer submits and signs HD-A-020, then a conflict-free leader signs with conflict_decision_ref QD-XL-001
acceptance.then: the first two calls return 409 CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST_BLOCKED with state unchanged; the leader call returns 200 SIGNED; audit contains both blocked attempts with actor, contractor and declaration CD-001

acceptance.given: a SIGNED construction contract with an unverified performance guarantee, no building permit and a capital commit that fails
acceptance.when: activate is called step by step as each condition is fixed
acceptance.then: results are 422 PERFORMANCE_GUARANTEE_MISSING, 422 PERMIT_GATE_BLOCKED (gate_code CONTRACT_ACTIVATION), 422 FUND_COMMIT_FAILED with the contract still SIGNED, then 200 ACTIVE with exactly one ctr.contract.activated.v1 and one ctr.commitment.changed.v1 outbox row

acceptance.given: the drafter signs their own contract and an approver above DoA limit signs a 25bn contract
acceptance.when: sign is called, also with extra fields status and tenant_id
acceptance.then: 403 SELF_APPROVAL_DENIED, 403 SCOPE_DENIED and 400 INVALID_REQUEST respectively; PATCH /contracts/{id} and PUT /resources/contract/{id} return 404 or 405

acceptance.given: contracts HD-S-01..09 in nine states
acceptance.when: every state x command pair is exercised with a distinct Idempotency-Key
acceptance.then: only the 10 listed transitions return 200 and every other pair returns 409 CONTRACT_STATE_INVALID; contract_status_change has exactly one row per valid transition; a direct UPDATE of status by the application role is refused

effort.assumption: Depends on cross-group interfaces that are not yet specified as stories: BID hasConflict(membership, contractor, at) (R-CTR-04), CAP COMMIT commit and AVC, ADM DoA resolution, DOC decision document. Stubs behind ports with contract tests until real stories land; confidence stays low until then. CAP checkAndCommit is provided by ST-CAP-005 and the DoA resolver by ST-ADM-011; the BID conflict check is a port with a test double until ST-BID-003 lands in R2.

acceptance.then: the 07-25 acceptance snapshots 2,000,000 (1,000,000,000 for 500 m3); the 08-02 acceptance snapshots 2,100,000 (210,000,000 for 100 m3); CO-002 returns 422 RETROACTIVE_NOT_ALLOWED

stories.title: Retention release by BOQ line with independent approver
